why: Academia.edu and ResearchGate both host a document titled 'Optimal Circle Packings for Triangular Numbers: A Detailed Mathematical Proof of the Erdős-Oler Conjecture', but these are self-published, unrefereed postings (not arXiv or a journal) and I could not pin a reliable date or verify the claim is genuine; the arXiv ID initially surfaced in search (2410.22842) turned out to be an unrelated Erdős-Gyárfás paper (search drift). Wikipedia's own 'Circle packing in an equilateral triangle' article still states the conjecture is only known true for n ≤ 15, with no indication of a recent update.
